notes: v512 — the 📓 Share Diary. Every share now has one dated timeline that gathers every comment you make anywhere in the app. Each entry is stamped automatically with the date AND the share's price that day — so six months on, 'looks like quiet accumulation' next to '$2.14' tells you honestly whether your eye was any good. Your buys and sells appear in the timeline too (▲ bought, ▼ sold with its exit badge), read live from your practice ledger, so the diary shows what you THOUGHT next to what actually HAPPENED. Your old research notes and trade notes were imported automatically as the first entries — nothing you've written is lost. Find it in any share's detail view, under the 📏 passport, with an add-a-note box; the '📓 Every share's diary' link opens all diaries with a search box that matches share codes or any words you've ever written. One honest rule: entries can be deleted but never edited — a diary you can quietly rewrite after a trade goes wrong isn't a diary. It lives on this device like everything else. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
